scope: native-default buffered text logging on declared WSL2 host
primary_metric: verified accepted records / time from measured start to producer stop and buffered drain completion
overall_index: equal-weight geometric mean of paired QLog/BQLog goodput ratios over the 8 fixed saturation scenarios; CI block bootstrap over 5 repetitions; not a universal production/SLA score
defaults: keep native ring/cache sizes, full policy, adaptive queue, formatter, prefix, timestamp, worker scheduling, and rolling defaults; only select text output paths, info level, and explicit independent mode where specified
sampling: 1 in 1021 attempts; 4096-bin log histogram with <=1/64 relative bin width above 64 ns; quantiles report bin upper bounds
validation: all output lines parsed; exact body, strict per-producer order, counts and two 64-bit fingerprints per producer/phase/target; not a collision-free cryptographic proof
exclusions: no per-trial outlier removal; nonzero exit or integrity failure aborts suite; preflight excluded; no durable or raw-device bandwidth claim
